boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study environments in UC Merced’s Kolligian Library, spanning quiet individual work, 24-hour access, technology-enabled workstations, and reservable group rooms.

cards.title: KL 155 First Floor Lantern
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · 24-hour study area
cards.notes: Use this first-come study area when you need late access; after-hours entry is through the library’s south sliding doors.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library study area with 24-hour access for eligible campus users.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library identifies KL 155, the First Floor Lantern, as a 24-hour, first-come study area for students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Students, staff, and faculty; first-come. The library directs after-hours users to the south sliding doors; check Library Hours for closures and finals-period changes.

cards.title: McFadden-Willis Reading Room
cards.subtitle: KL 455 · Kolligian Library fourth floor
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor for a designated quiet setting, then choose an individual seat for reading or focused coursework.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study room on the library’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library designates the McFadden-Willis Reading Room, KL 455, as a quiet study area and lists it as first-come for students, staff, and faculty.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor; first-come for students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab
cards.subtitle: KL 260 · Kolligian Library second floor
cards.notes: Bring a data, software, or digital project and use an open workstation during lab hours; confirm availability around workshops.
cards.short_summary: An informal technology workspace with 12 PC workstations and presentation tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab in KL 260 has 12 PC workstations, a projection screen, a digital whiteboard, and access for students, faculty, and staff during open lab hours.
cards.source_title: Gonella Discovery Room Data Lab | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Second floor across from the elevators. Visit during open lab hours; workshops or reservations may modify availability.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 264
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Reserve this room for an academic group assignment, then connect a device to the monitor and use the glass whiteboards to plan together.
cards.short_summary: A reservable small-group room with display, charging, HDMI, and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library lists KL 264 among its Collaborative Work Rooms, which support academic group assignments and collaborative study for up to six people.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Undergraduate and graduate students may reserve via EMS up to 48 hours ahead for one- or two-hour blocks; no key is required.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 265
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Book this room for focused academic collaboration and use its monitor, table power, and whiteboards to keep shared work visible.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped Collaborative Work Room for academic group work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library lists Collaborative Work Rooms from KL 264 through KL 376 for academic activities, group assignments, and collaborative study.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Undergraduate and graduate students may reserve via EMS; rooms in the KL 264–KL 376 range accommodate up to six people.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 266
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Schedule an academic work session here and bring an HDMI-capable device to share slides, drafts, or research with your group.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library room designed for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library’s Collaborative Work Rooms include a fixed table, large flat-panel monitor, charging ports, HDMI connection, and three glass whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through EMS for academic use. Reservations are limited to one per day and two per week per user.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 267
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Use a reserved block for a team problem set or project review, and clear the room promptly if your group leaves for more than 30 minutes.
cards.short_summary: A small, reservable setting for academic teams.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library identifies KL 267 within the KL 264–KL 376 Collaborative Work Room range for academic activities, group assignments, and collaborative study.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Undergraduate and graduate students may reserve. A reservation expires when the room is empty for more than 30 minutes.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 268
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Reserve ahead for a small academic group, then use the installed display and three glass whiteboards to structure the session.
cards.short_summary: A six-person-capacity Collaborative Work Room with shared work tools.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library lists KL 268 within its Collaborative Work Room range; rooms KL 264–KL 376 accommodate up to six people.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Use EMS to reserve up to 48 hours in advance in one- or two-hour blocks; head directly to the room at the reservation time.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 269
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Plan a group assignment here, using the table’s USB and outlet charging plus the monitor connection for shared working materials.
cards.short_summary: A reservable academic group-work room with charging and display connections.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library includes KL 269 in the KL 264–KL 376 Collaborative Work Room range and specifies table charging ports, HDMI, a monitor, and glass whiteboards for these rooms.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: For undergraduate and graduate students’ academic use. Back-to-back group reservations are not permitted.

cards.title: Collaborative Work Room KL 270
cards.subtitle: Kolligian Library · reservable group-study room
cards.notes: Set up an academic collaboration session in advance, then use the room’s shared screen and whiteboards to work through a project together.
cards.short_summary: A small library room reserved for collaborative study and group assignments.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Merced Library identifies KL 270 as part of its KL 264–KL 376 Collaborative Work Room range, available for academic activities, group assignments, and collaborative study.
cards.source_title: Study & Collaborative Spaces | UC Merced Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve through EMS up to 48 hours ahead. No key is required; rooms in this range accommodate up to six people.
